name: Default
shortDescription: Automation engine that runs business processes declared as YAML task templates, with an encrypted PostgreSQL audit trail and a web dashboard.

alerts.message: The dashboard is at /ui/dashboard/ and asks for HTTP basic auth: sign in as admin with the UTASK_ADMIN_PASSWORD value from the environment. Task templates are YAML files mounted into /app/templates; edit or add mounts to change them.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
